title: ReStore config.json
description: The ReStore configuration file (default %USERPROFILE%\ReStore\config.json). Unknown top-level keys are preserved when ReStore rewrites the file, but 'config set' refuses them (typo protection) unless --force. Provider option values may be plain text, 'env:NAME' (read from the environment when used) or 'dpapi:...' (Windows DPAPI, written by 'config protect' or '--protect'). Paths and options accept %VAR% environment references.

configSchemaVersion.description: Version of this file's layout. Maintained by ReStore (older files are migrated automatically with a backup); do not edit.

watchDirectories.description: Folders that are backed up. Each entry is an object with a path and an optional storage type; 'config add-watch' and 'config remove-watch' edit the list.

path.description: Folder to back up. May contain %VAR% references such as %USERPROFILE%\Documents.

storageType.description: Key of a storageSources entry used for this folder; null uses globalStorageType.

schedule.description: When this folder is backed up on a clock instead of the global backupInterval: every <N>m|h|d (at least 5m), daily HH:mm[,HH:mm...], weekdays HH:mm, weekends HH:mm, <days> HH:mm (mon,wed,fri or mon-fri), weekly <day> HH:mm, monthly <1-28|last> HH:mm, cron <5 fields> or off. Local time; absent uses backupInterval. 'config set-schedule' edits it.

globalStorageType.description: Key of the storageSources entry used by default (folders without their own storageType, system backup, probe).

backupInterval.description: How often the scheduler backs up each folder, as a .NET TimeSpan (d.hh:mm:ss), for example 01:00:00. Must be greater than zero.

sizeThresholdMB.description: Change size in megabytes after which a folder is backed up without waiting for the interval. Must be greater than zero.

maxFileSizeMB.description: Files larger than this many megabytes are skipped. Must be greater than zero.

backupType.description: Backup engine. ChunkSnapshot (deduplicated snapshots) is the supported mode; the others are legacy.

retention.description: Which snapshots are kept; older ones are deleted after backups.

enabled.description: Apply the retention policy after backups. When false nothing is ever deleted.

keepLastPerDirectory.description: Always keep at least this many of the newest snapshots per folder.

maxAgeDays.description: Snapshots older than this many days may be deleted (subject to keepLastPerDirectory and mode). 0 disables the age rule.

keepHourly.description: Keep the newest snapshot of each of the last N hours. 0 turns the tier off.

keepDaily.description: Keep the newest snapshot of each of the last N days. 0 turns the tier off.

keepWeekly.description: Keep the newest snapshot of each of the last N weeks. 0 turns the tier off.

keepMonthly.description: Keep the newest snapshot of each of the last N months. 0 turns the tier off.

keepYearly.description: Keep the newest snapshot of each of the last N years. 0 turns the tier off.

mode.description: 'any' keeps a snapshot when any rule wants it; 'all' only when every enabled rule does.

chunkDiffing.description: Tuning of the chunking engine. The defaults suit almost everyone; changing chunk sizes starts a new deduplication history.

manifestVersion.description: Snapshot manifest format. 3 is the newest (encrypted repositories use it for key wrapping); 0 means 'leave to ReStore'.

compression.description: 'auto' compresses chunks that benefit; 'off' stores them as they are.

minChunkSizeKB.description: Smallest chunk in kilobytes. Must not exceed targetChunkSizeKB.

targetChunkSizeKB.description: Average chunk size in kilobytes. Must lie between min and max.

rollingHashWindowSize.description: Window of the rolling hash that finds chunk boundaries (8 to 512 bytes).

maxChunksPerFile.description: Safety limit of chunks per file; larger files are skipped and reported.

maxFilesPerSnapshot.description: Safety limit of files per snapshot.

verification.description: Scheduled integrity checks of stored snapshots.

verifyInterval.description: How often verification runs, as a TimeSpan (for example 7.00:00:00). Must be greater than zero when enabled.

localStorageOnly.description: Only verify snapshots on local storage (remote verification downloads data and may cost money).

snapshotsPerRun.description: How many snapshots each run verifies.

mode.description: full re-reads every chunk, sample re-reads a percentage, quick checks existence and size only.

samplePercent.description: Percentage of chunks re-read in sample mode.

notifications.description: Desktop notifications of the ReStore app.

notifyOnRecovery.description: Notify when backups work again after a failure.

logging.description: Log file settings (restore.log under the data folder).

protection.description: Background protection behaviour of the ReStore app.

autoStart.description: Start protecting (watching and scheduling) automatically when the app starts.

telemetry.description: Anonymous usage statistics. Never contains paths, file names, group names, host or user names.

crashReports.description: Scrubbed crash reports (exception types, redacted messages, method-name stack frames; no paths): ask each time (default), always send, or never. Requires telemetry to be enabled.

checkAutomatically.description: Check for a new ReStore version in the background.

backupWindow.description: Quiet hours: automatic work (scheduled and watcher-triggered backups, the system backup, scheduled verification and retention) only starts inside this window. Manual backups always run and a backup already running may finish. Work due outside the window waits for it to open. Local time; the start is inclusive, the end exclusive; the window may cross midnight and start equal to end means the whole day.

enabled.description: False keeps the window in the file without applying it.

start.description: Local time of day (HH:mm) the window opens.

end.description: Local time of day (HH:mm) the window closes; earlier than start means the next morning, equal to start means the whole day.

days.description: The days a window starts on: all, weekdays, weekends or days such as mon,wed,fri or mon-fri.

watcher.description: Change-triggered backups by the file watcher.

minSnapshotInterval.description: Minimum time between two watcher-triggered snapshots of a folder, as a TimeSpan (00:00:00 disables the minimum).

maxDebounceWait.description: Longest a continuously changing folder waits before it is backed up, as a TimeSpan (00:00:00 disables the cap).

deepScanIntervalDays.description: Every N days a backup re-reads all files instead of trusting size and timestamp. 0 deep-scans on every run.

hydrateCloudFiles.description: Download cloud-only placeholder files (OneDrive and similar) so they are backed up; otherwise they are skipped.

systemBackup.description: Backup of installed programs, environment variables, Windows settings and developer tools (Windows only).

includePrograms.description: Include the list of installed programs.

includeDevTools.description: Include developer tool configuration (git, shells, editors).

includeSshConfig.description: Include the SSH configuration (keys are never included).

backupInterval.description: How often the system backup runs, as a TimeSpan (for example 1.00:00:00).

schedule.description: Clock schedule of the system backup instead of backupInterval (every <N>m|h|d (at least 5m), daily HH:mm[,HH:mm...], weekdays HH:mm, weekends HH:mm, <days> HH:mm (mon,wed,fri or mon-fri), weekly <day> HH:mm, monthly <1-28|last> HH:mm, cron <5 fields> or off). Absent uses systemBackup.backupInterval.

excludeSystemPrograms.description: Regular expressions of program names left out of the programs list.

storageType.description: Storage for all system backup components; null uses globalStorageType.

programsStorageType.description: Storage for the programs component only; null uses storageType.

environmentStorageType.description: Storage for the environment variables component only; null uses storageType.

settingsStorageType.description: Storage for the Windows settings component only; null uses storageType.

devToolsStorageType.description: Storage for the developer tools component only; null uses storageType.

encryption.description: Client-side encryption (AES-256-GCM). Use 'encryption enable' / 'encryption disable' instead of editing these by hand.

salt.description: Base64 random salt of the password key derivation. Generated by 'encryption enable'; losing it makes the password check fail.

keyDerivationIterations.description: PBKDF2-SHA256 iterations used to derive the key from the password.

verificationToken.description: Base64 token that proves a password is the right one without storing it.

excludedPatterns.description: File name patterns (wildcards * and ?) that are never backed up, matched against the file name.

excludedPaths.description: Folders (may contain %VAR%) that are never backed up, with everything below them.

excludePresets.description: Built-in exclusion sets to apply: dev (build output, node_modules), caches, office-temp, system.

excludeGlobs.description: Directory-aware glob exclusions relative to the watched folder (for example **/node_modules/**); unlike excludedPatterns they can prune whole folders.

storageSources.description: Where backups are written, keyed by storage type: local, s3, gdrive, dropbox, github, azure, gcp, sftp, b2. 'config set-storage' edits an entry; 'probe' tests it.

local.description: A folder on this computer, a drive or a network share.

path.description: Backup folder. The only provider that uses the top-level path as its root; created when missing.
Backup folder (same as the top-level path; the top-level path is copied here when absent).

prefix.description: Optional sub-folder inside the backup folder; must not start with / or contain ..

gdrive.description: Google Drive (installed-app OAuth). Sign in once with 'auth gdrive'.

path.description: Ignored by remote providers; use options.prefix instead.

client_id.description: OAuth client ID from the Google Cloud console (Desktop app).

client_secret.description: OAuth client secret. Secret: use env:NAME, --protect or --value-stdin.

token_folder.description: Where the sign-in token is cached; a relative name lives under the data folder (tokens/). Optional.

backup_folder_name.description: Name of the Drive folder that holds backups. Optional; default ReStoreBackups.

prefix.description: Optional sub-folder inside the repository location; must not start with / or contain ..

path.description: Ignored by remote providers; use options.prefix instead.

secretAccessKey.description: AWS secret access key. Secret: use env:NAME, --protect or --value-stdin.

region.description: AWS region of the bucket, for example eu-west-1.

serviceUrl.description: Optional endpoint URL of an S3-compatible service (MinIO, Wasabi, Cloudflare R2, Ceph, ...), for example http://localhost:9000. Path-style addressing is used. Leave unset for Amazon S3.

prefix.description: Optional key prefix (sub-folder) inside the bucket; must not start with / or contain ..

path.description: Ignored by remote providers; use options.prefix instead.

token.description: Personal access token with repository write access. Secret: use env:NAME, --protect or --value-stdin.

prefix.description: Optional sub-folder inside the repository; must not start with / or contain ..

path.description: Ignored by remote providers; use options.prefix instead.

connectionString.description: Storage account connection string. Secret: use env:NAME, --protect or --value-stdin.

prefix.description: Optional blob prefix (sub-folder) inside the container; must not start with / or contain ..

path.description: Ignored by remote providers; use options.prefix instead.

bucketName.description: Name of the Cloud Storage bucket.

credentialPath.description: Path of a service account key file. Optional: application default credentials are used when absent.

prefix.description: Optional object prefix (sub-folder) inside the bucket; must not start with / or contain ..

dropbox.description: Dropbox. Authorise with 'auth dropbox' (two steps) to obtain the refresh token.

path.description: Ignored by remote providers; use options.prefix instead.

options.description: Provider options: either accessToken, or refreshToken together with appKey and appSecret.

accessToken.description: Short-lived access token (expires; prefer refreshToken). Secret.

refreshToken.description: Long-lived refresh token written by 'auth dropbox --code'. Secret.

appKey.description: Dropbox app key. Secret-class value: use env:NAME, --protect or --value-stdin.

appSecret.description: Dropbox app secret. Secret: use env:NAME, --protect or --value-stdin.

prefix.description: Optional sub-folder of the app folder; must not start with / or contain ..

path.description: Ignored by remote providers; use options.prefix instead.

options.description: Provider options: host and username, plus a password or a private key.

password.description: Login password. Secret: use env:NAME, --protect or --value-stdin.

privateKeyPath.description: Path of a private key file used instead of a password.

passphrase.description: Passphrase of the private key. Secret; optional.

hostKeyFingerprint.description: Expected server key fingerprint, SHA256:... as printed by ssh-keygen -lf. Optional but recommended.

prefix.description: Optional sub-folder on the server; must not start with / or contain ..

path.description: Ignored by remote providers; use options.prefix instead.

applicationKey.description: Application key. Secret: use env:NAME, --protect or --value-stdin.

serviceUrl.description: S3 endpoint of the bucket's region, for example https://s3.us-west-004.backblazeb2.com.

prefix.description: Optional key prefix (sub-folder) inside the bucket; must not start with / or contain ..

additionalProperties.description: A storage source with a custom name.
